title: land reruns the done checks of sprint siblings whose touches share a file with the landing item, so a landing that breaks a sibling's repro stops at its own landing
goal: SP-6jfnx5i3 retrospective: BG-vxwibl62 (holder-only put) landed after BG-p2jcpxhl and broke BG-p2jcpxhl's repro, which put on a leased key without the holder's token; each landing ran only its own checks, so only the review story's done (rerun_done_checks) found it, and the orchestrator reopened BG-p2jcpxhl to correct the repro. A landing reruns the checks and repros of the sprint's done items whose touches share a file with its own and stops on one that fails.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land;sys.exit(0 if hasattr(bl_land,'rerun_sibling_checks') else 1)
